header.title: Services
header.subtitle: Six capabilities. One single standard: results in production.
header.intro: We organize by capability, not by industry. Specificity comes from the work the real problem, its constraints and its data not from a sector template.

ai.name: Artificial Intelligence
ai.tagline: We take AI from pilot to production, with ROI metrics, not a demo.
ai.desc: AI doesn't fail because of technology; it fails in implementation. We design, integrate and operate AI solutions embedded in the real workflow, measured against a business objective defined upfront.
bullets: Copilots and assistants embedded in the workflow, not in a separate tab
RAG over your own sources, with citation and hallucination control
Agents that execute scoped tasks with guardrails and traceability
Reproducible data-to-model pipelines, versioned and deployed
Evaluation and observability: quality, cost and latency metrics live

cybersecurity.name: Cybersecurity
cybersecurity.tagline: Comprehensive protection of digital assets through vulnerability management, continuous monitoring and incident response.
cybersecurity.desc: Security is not a product you install: it is a practice you operate. We design and operate your organization's security posture to reduce risk in a measurable, sustained way.
bullets: Vulnerability assessment and management across infrastructure, applications and cloud
Continuous monitoring and incident response with defined processes
Penetration testing and controlled exercises on real systems
Platform hardening and least-privilege access control
Guidance on compliance and information security

infrastructure.name: Infrastructure
infrastructure.tagline: Design, implementation and management of high-availability technology infrastructure, on-premise and hybrid.
infrastructure.desc: Business operations rest on infrastructure. We design it for real constraints scale, budget and team and manage it so availability is the norm, not the exception.
bullets: Design and implementation of enterprise networking, compute and storage
Virtualization and consolidation of on-premise and hybrid platforms
High availability, backup and disaster recovery
Administration, maintenance and support of the technology platform
Documentation and monitoring as a permanent practice

cloud.name: Cloud
cloud.tagline: Architecture, migration and optimization of workloads across public, private and hybrid cloud environments.
cloud.desc: The cloud is not a destination: it is an operating model. We support adoption with architecture, planned migrations and continuous optimization of performance and cost.
bullets: Solution architecture across public, private and hybrid cloud
Planned workload migration without disrupting operations
Deployment automation and infrastructure as code
Cost (FinOps) and workload performance optimization
Security and governance of cloud environments by design

critical.name: Critical services
critical.tagline: Operation and support of mission-critical systems with business continuity and service level agreement (SLA) compliance.
critical.desc: Some systems cannot stop. We operate them with permanent monitoring, continuity processes and service level agreements that are measured and met.
bullets: Operation and support of mission-critical systems
Proactive monitoring and incidents with agreed response times
Business continuity and disaster recovery plans
Change management and maintenance windows without surprises
Periodic SLA compliance and platform health reports

software.name: Software solutions
software.tagline: Custom software development under quality, scalability and maintainability standards.
software.desc: Generic tools force the business to bend to their shape. We build custom software that fits your operation exactly: maintainable, scalable and ready to grow.
bullets: Discovery that scopes the work to the problem that truly matters
Architecture designed for real constraints: scale, budget and team
Web and mobile applications focused on performance and usability
APIs and services designed to integrate, not to lock you in
End-to-end ownership: from first sketch to production and operations

pricing.title: How we start
pricing.text: We don't publish prices. Every engagement is sized against your problem, your context and the outcome that needs to move not against a catalog rate.
